title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in seowriting…
description: SEOWriting versions up to and including 1.15.0 are affected by a stored Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability. This flaw involves improper neutralization of input during web page generation, allowing attackers to inject malicious scripts that can execute in users' browsers. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.1.
